Standard Chartered Approved for Wealth Products in GIFT City

Standard Chartered has received approval from the International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA) to launch wealth management products from Gujarat International Finance Tec-City (GIFT City). This marks the bank's initial retail-focused offering from GIFT City. The move signifies foreign banks increasing their engagement in India's wealth management sector, extending beyond traditional wholesale banking operations.
